installIntro.message: Downloading videos and MP3 needs yt-dlp (the open-source tool that downloads videos), ffmpeg (joins video and audio, converts to MP3) and deno (a runtime yt-dlp needs) on your computer, plus this project's helper (lets the browser use them). About 150 MB in total, installed only for your user account, and you can remove it at any time.
